details:
Currently, VRChat client available in Viveport is build 1133, while Steam provides build 1134.
These builds and responsible SDKs have different Unity versions (2019.4.30f1 and Unity 2019.4.31f1), and although it is true that content that was uploaded with the older Unity is supported by the newer Unity, the reverse is not correct, and that results in Viveport version of VRChat not loading contents uploaded with Unity 2019.4.31f1, showing error avatars for example. With lots of new contents published everyday with latest SDK, it is quite a pain and deters anyone from using Viveport client even more.
While I can ask to update the Viveport version, I would want to push forward and ask to keep the Viveport version of VRChat client, or all VRChat clients in maintained stores, up to date. This might include adding Viveport client update to the release checklist, doing some automation, or withdrawing VRChat from Viveport for the reason that it is not or would not be up to date.
In my personal preference, if I could choose from Steam and Viveport to launch VRChat, I would choose Viveport, because the UI buttons are bigger and easier to click with HMD and VR controllers, and I don't want to get bothered by Steam presenting my VRChat playtime (it would be over 1000 hrs)
title: Viveport version of VRChat is out of date again
